name: Protean Technique (Combat, Technique)
body:
You strike in a chaotic and unpredictable fashion, using your momentum to both strike and deflect.

Prerequisite: Combat Expertise, Dodge, base attack bonus +7

Benefit: Whenever you make an attack roll and make a natural roll of a 19 or 20, you gain a +1 dodge bonus to AC. Whenever you make an attack roll and make a natural roll of a 1 or 2, you gain a +1 bonus to attack rolls. These bonuses stack, up to +2 each. You must move at least 10 feet or make at least one attack each round to maintain these bonuses, otherwise the bonuses are lost and must be gained again.
